card.name: May/can before 'be taken with food'
card.fires_on: The modal words 'may' or 'can' right after a drug name or 'and', in dosing instructions that go on to say the drug can be taken with or without food.

modes.label: Drug name then may/can
modes.description: The modal follows a drug or tablet name as its subject, leading into 'be taken with or without food'.
modes.example: 2.2 Use with Food Sildenafil tablets<< may>> be taken with or without food.

modes.label: And then may
modes.description: The modal follows 'and' after a statement about oral or daily dosing, leading into a food or swallowing option.
